description: Extended extraction schema for the 2026 re-run of the ICS LCWIP/PCT data ingest. Includes explicit mention counts, term breakdowns, PCT screenshot counts, usage depth levels, and OCR/text-layer flags.

fields.name: pdf_url
fields.prompt: What is the URL of the PDF or web document?

fields.name: report_name
fields.prompt: What is the name/title of the report or document?

fields.name: date_published
fields.prompt: What is the publication date of the report? (YYYY-MM-DD or Month YYYY)

fields.name: doc_type
fields.prompt: Classify the document type. Use one of: 'LCWIP' (a Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan or its technical/background report), 'LCWIP-related' (other active travel strategy, BSIP, cycling/walking delivery plan, or consultation that references cycle network planning), or 'other' (not directly an active-travel planning document).

fields.name: mentions_pct
fields.prompt: Does the report mention the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) or the underlying PCT methodology? (true/false)

fields.name: n_mentions_pct
fields.prompt: Total count of explicit mentions of PCT / Propensity to Cycle Tool / pct.bike in the document text (integer numeric, 0 if none).

fields.name: pct_term_breakdown
fields.prompt: Breakdown of mention counts by key term e.g. {'pct': N, 'propensity_to_cycle_tool': N, 'pct_bike': N}.

fields.name: n_screenshots_pct
fields.prompt: How many screenshots, figures, maps, or visual exports from the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) are present in the report? (integer numeric, 0 if none).

fields.name: pct_usage_depth
fields.prompt: Overall depth of PCT usage: '0 - None', '1 - Passing mention', '2 - Contextual background / data input', '3 - Network design & mapping', or '4 - Core prioritisation & funding framework'.

fields.name: other_tools_used
fields.prompt: What other cycle/walk network planning tools or data sources were used in the report? List all mentioned (e.g. NPT Scotland, CRUSE, OSM, DfT road traffic stats, local models).

fields.name: how_pct_was_used
fields.prompt: How was the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) used in the report? Describe the role it played in evidence, network design, or prioritisation.

fields.name: pct_scenarios_used
fields.prompt: Which PCT scenarios are referenced? List any of: 'Government Target', 'Go Dutch', 'E-bike', 'Go Cambridge', 'Dutch Standards', 'Current'/'Baseline', or other named scenario.

fields.name: pct_data_sources
fields.prompt: Which PCT data inputs/sources are referenced? List any of: 'Census 2011 commuting', 'school travel', 'desire lines', 'jittering', 'ORS', or other.

fields.name: desire_lines_used
fields.prompt: Were PCT 'desire lines' (straight-line potential flows) specifically used or referenced? (true/false)

fields.name: prioritisation_integration
fields.prompt: Was PCT output integrated into a prioritisation matrix, scoring, or route-ranking method? (true/false)

fields.name: other_tools_developed
fields.prompt: Were any other tools or methods developed as part of the report? If so, describe them.

fields.name: specific_evidence_of_impact
fields.prompt: Is there any specific evidence of the impact of using the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT)? E.g. secured funding, changed route choice, quantified demand.

fields.name: quotes_on_using_pct
fields.prompt: Are there any direct quotes on using the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT)? List all quotes if present.

fields.name: local_authority_name
fields.prompt: What is the name of the local authority (or authorities) the document covers?

fields.name: combined_authority_name
fields.prompt: What is the name of the combined authority, if any?

fields.name: region
fields.prompt: Which region of England does this document primarily cover? (e.g. North East, North West, Yorkshire and The Humber, East Midlands, West Midlands, East of England, London, South East, South West)

fields.name: length_of_cycle_network_proposed
fields.prompt: What is the length of the cycle network proposed? (as stated in the report, verbatim if possible)

fields.name: total_cost_of_network
fields.prompt: What is the total cost of the network? (as stated in the report, verbatim if possible)

fields.name: length_of_network_km
fields.prompt: What is the total length of the network in kilometers? (numeric, if available)

fields.name: total_cost_pounds
fields.prompt: What is the total cost of the network in pounds? (numeric, if available)

fields.name: routes
fields.prompt: How many routes are included in the plan? (numeric, if available)

fields.name: has_text_layer
fields.prompt: Does the document have a native text layer? (true/false, false if scanned/OCR was needed)

fields.name: extraction_notes
fields.prompt: Any notes on extraction quality, scanned/unreadable pages, or ambiguity. Keep brief.
